data.one_liner: Flutter implementation of the Microsoft Azure Cognitive Text-To-Speech API.
data.what_it_does: It provides a Flutter client for Microsoft Azure Cognitive Text-to-Speech with support for standard audio generation, real-time audio streaming, advanced voice filtering, and caching.
use_when: You need to convert text to speech inside a Flutter app using Microsoft Azure.
You require real-time audio streaming and progress tracking for text-to-speech tasks.
You want built-in caching and robust retry logic for Azure TTS requests.
avoid_when: You need on-device, offline text-to-speech synthesis.
You use a cloud text-to-speech provider other than Microsoft Azure.
strengths: Supports both standard generation and real-time audio streaming.
Includes a powerful voice filtering API and builder pattern.
Provides comprehensive error handling and built-in caching.
weaknesses: Requires an active Microsoft Azure subscription key and region.
Dependent on internet connectivity for API calls.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the framework with your Azure subscription key and region.
